# Vendored third-party source

`ThirdParty/libtailscale/` is plain source committed into this repository. It
used to be a git submodule (with a second submodule nested inside it); see
revision R16 and decision D2 in `../../docs/PLAN-REVISIONS.md` and
`../../docs/DECISIONS.md` for why that changed.

## What is here, and from where

| Path | Upstream repository | Revision |
|---|---|---|
| `ThirdParty/libtailscale/` | https://github.com/tailscale/libtailscale, as patched in the aperture-plus fork network | `f55900d2efb7ccc327a9ac07779b92767c1e48ab` |
| `ThirdParty/libtailscale/tailscale-patched/` | https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale, as patched in the aperture-plus fork network | `b5adfd852c01a53025cbacc0727789984ffbf427` |

Neither commit is in the public libtailscale or tailscale repositories. Both
are carried as unreferenced objects inside
https://github.com/tailscale/aperture-plus (that is what its submodules'
`url = .` meant) and are fetchable from there by SHA:

```bash
git init /tmp/lt && cd /tmp/lt
git fetch --depth 1 https://github.com/tailscale/aperture-plus f55900d2efb7ccc327a9ac07779b92767c1e48ab
git fetch --depth 1 https://github.com/tailscale/aperture-plus b5adfd852c01a53025cbacc0727789984ffbf427
```

`tailscale-patched` was a submodule nested inside libtailscale at the path
above; its content now sits in that directory directly.

## The import

The first commit that added this tree is import-only: byte-for-byte both
upstream trees at the revisions above, the gitlinks and `.gitmodules` removed,
and this file added. Nothing else. It was verified by comparing the mode and
blob hash of every one of the 2,867 staged entries against `git ls-tree -r`
of the two pinned commits; all matched. Identical blob hashes mean identical
bytes.

Every Latchkey modification to this tree is a **later, separate commit**, so
`git log -- ThirdParty/libtailscale` lists exactly what differs from upstream.

## Diffing against upstream

Because the import commit is pristine, the Latchkey delta is simply:

```bash
IMPORT=$(git log --format=%H --diff-filter=A -- ThirdParty/VENDORED.md | tail -1)
git diff "$IMPORT" -- ThirdParty/libtailscale
```

To compare against a newer upstream revision, fetch it as above, export it,
and diff the trees:

```bash
git -C /tmp/lt archive <sha> | tar -x -C /tmp/lt-new
diff -ru /tmp/lt-new ThirdParty/libtailscale --exclude=tailscale-patched --exclude=build
```

## Tracking upstream

**Cherry-pick only** (revision R16). No merges: upstream changes are reviewed
and brought over commit by commit, for the vendored tree and for `TSNet/`.
The last upstream revision reviewed is recorded in `../../docs/DECISIONS.md`.

## Build products

`swift/build/` (the TailscaleKit xcframework, ~180 MB) is ignored by
libtailscale's own `.gitignore`, which git honours in this subdirectory. It is
regenerated by `make framework` and never committed.
